title: Seven new LEGO Star Wars sets for the 50th anniversary
intro: LEGO has revealed the first sets for Star Wars' 50th anniversary in 2027. Six are out on 1 January and the biggest, a 3,209-piece movie poster, follows on 4 January.
body: The wave mixes playsets with display pieces. The new Rebel Y-Wing Starfighter has an all-new cockpit and canopy, and two duel sets recreate famous fights: Luke and Vader in Cloud City, and Anakin and Obi-Wan on Mustafar.
For display shelves there's a buildable Luke Skywalker over 26 cm tall, a Stormtrooper helmet based on the original concept art, a 2 in 1 Darth Vader wall art set, and the A New Hope Movie Poster.

Four of the sets come with a new concept art minifigure, based on the earliest designs for the films: Luke in the Y-Wing, Darth Vader in Duel on Bespin, Han Solo in Mustafar Duel and Princess Leia with the Up-Scaled Luke. The sets also come in new boxes with a 50th anniversary logo.
Australian prices aren't out yet. The sets show up in BrickCollect as soon as the catalog has them, so you can add them to your Wanted list.
